text_markup: The Runner encounters a copy of {card:Lancelot} hosting a condition counter from {card:Sub Boost}. The Corp reveals a copy of {card:Merlin} in HQ to add a "[sub] Do 2 net damage." subroutine to {card:Lancelot}. The Corp declares whether the subroutine from {card:Merlin} will be added before {card:Lancelot}'s printed "[sub] Trash 1 installed program." subroutine, between the printed subroutine and the "[sub] End the run." subroutine granted by the condition counter, or after the "[sub] End the run." subroutine.
